topic: How does elevation angle variation in ground terminals affect signal attenuation modeling and satellite coverage optimization?
consensus_response: Elevation angle variation in ground terminals affects signal attenuation modeling and satellite coverage optimization through changes in path loss, atmospheric absorption, and scattering. At lower frequencies (e.g., S-band), path loss dominates, while at higher frequencies (e.g., Ka-band), atmospheric effects become more significant. The Fontan LMS model requires longer sampling sequences due to changing statistical properties, increasing the cost in terms of capacity and reliability. Polarization correlation coefficient variations influence array factor and interference patterns, necessitating sophisticated equalization techniques to mitigate multipath effects.
